defs.def: to make sth happen in a particular way or be of a particular type 决定；形成；支配；影响

ex.s: These two pieces of information - the time of day and the point where the sun is in the sky - allow the butterfly to determine the way to go.
ex.t: 这两条信息——一天中的时间和太阳在天空中的位置——使蝴蝶能够确定前进的方向。

ex.s: In 2013, I was determined to make my dream come true: I would become Australia's first professional photo blogger.
ex.t: 2013年，我决心实现我的梦想：成为澳大利亚第一位专业的摄影博主。

ex.s: He was determined to help other children have clean water.
ex.t: 他决心帮助其他孩子获得清洁的水。

ex.s: This insight grew from the determined attitude of a six-year-old boy who had the courage and perseverance to make his dream a reality.
ex.t: 这份远见源自一个六岁男孩坚定的态度，他拥有将梦想变为现实的勇气和毅力。

ex.s: Although my legs were tired from walking around the city, I was determined to see the painting, which is often called the “Mona Lisa of the North”.
ex.t: 虽然我的腿因在城市里四处走动而疲惫，但我决心要看到那幅常被称为"北方的蒙娜丽莎"的画作。

defs.def: to officially decide and/or arrange sth 确定；裁决；安排
